threads.title: FY26 operating cash flow
threads.evidence: Management projected a significant positive operating cash flow for FY26, but delivered ₹-600 cr.

history.speaker: Jairam Sampath
history.quote: So this year, you can expect at consol level, definitely a significant positive operating cash flow.

threads.title: FY28 revenue target
threads.evidence: Management reiterated the FY28 revenue target of $1 billion across calls.

history.speaker: Jairam Sampath
history.quote: There is good traction and there is good momentum in the business. So $1 billion by FY '28, certainly visibility is there, and we are sure we'll do it.

history.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan
history.quote: See, on the growth, what we have projected $1 billion, we are still sticking on to that because for us, from our bare board, from our OSAT, additional buildings are going to take place.

target.text: Turn the cash positive by end of the financial year

history.target: Turn the cash positive by end of the financial year

threads.title: FY27 OSAT and PCB full year revenue
threads.evidence: Management committed to a full-year FY27 revenue of INR450 to INR500 crores for OSAT and PCB.

history.speaker: N. Muthukumar
history.quote: and we have committed a full year revenue of totally INR500 crores between both, INR450 to INR500 crores, which is what we are targeting at this point in time, we are on the target.

threads.title: FY27 OSAT and PCB capex
threads.initial_target: INR300 crores each for OSAT and PCB

target.text: INR300 crores each for OSAT and PCB

threads.evidence: Management stated FY27 capex plans of INR300 crores each for OSAT and PCB, and reported being on track.

history.target: INR300 crores each for OSAT and PCB
history.speaker: Inderjeet Agarwal
history.quote: We said we will be funding for this capex for this year is about INR300 crores for OSAT, INR300 crores for PCB, and about INR250 crores for EMS business. We are on track for that.

threads.title: FY26 net working capital days
threads.evidence: Management expected net working capital days between 70 and 85 days for March 2026, but delivered figures do not report working capital days.

history.speaker: Jairam Sampath
history.quote: So typically, what we expect is about between 70 to 85 days. Last year, it was 85 days.

threads.title: Phase 1 PC Board business capex
threads.evidence: Management stated a cumulative capex of INR1,400 crores for the PC Board business, but delivered figures do not track this specific cumulative metric.

history.speaker: Jairam Sampath
history.quote: That means we'll spend about cumulatively INR1,400 crores in the PC Board business.

threads.title: OSAT business minimum revenue
threads.evidence: Management guided a minimum revenue of INR1,500 crores from the OSAT business without a specific timeline, and delivered figures do not provide segment breakdowns.

history.speaker: Jairam Sampath
history.quote: So, at the minimum, you can expect INR1,500 crores from our OSAT business.

threads.title: PC Board business minimum revenue

history.speaker: Jairam Sampath
history.quote: Similarly, you can expect about INR1,000 crores from PC Board business.

threads.title: Phase 1 OSAT business capex
threads.evidence: Management stated Phase 1 OSAT capex of INR1,700 to INR1,800 crores, but delivered figures do not break down project-specific capex.

history.speaker: Jairam Sampath
history.quote: And then, of course, the OSAT business, the Phase 1 will get completed that is about INR1,700 crores, INR1,800 crores of capex.

business.text: Kaynes Technology India Ltd is an integrated electronics system design and manufacturing (ESDM) enterprise that provides concept-to-lifecycle solutions to global and domestic OEMs. It sells to high-entry-barrier sectors like aerospace, defence, automotive, EVs, and railways, generating revenue through the sale of electronic manufacturing goods and services.
